spec.headline: Paid Search & YouTube Strategy | E-Commerce Acquisition | Measurement
spec.headline_rationale: Mars Men needs hands-on Google/YouTube acquisition, bid/budget strategy, testing and accurate measurement. Use source-supported search, YouTube client consulting, commerce scale and conversion analytics without inventing supplement/subscription or Northbeam experience.
spec.summary: Paid search marketer experienced in e-commerce acquisition, campaign optimization and measurable scale. Evaluated smart bidding, incremental CPA, Performance Max and Shopping, and consulted with agency clients across search, display, remarketing and YouTube. Scaled monthly marketing volume fourfold while improving ROAS from 1.5 to 3.5, supported by audience analysis, conversion tests and budget decisions. Advanced spreadsheet work, automated reporting and GA4/GTM measurement provide practical tools for diagnosing performance changes and identifying efficient growth opportunities.
spec.factual_review: Read exact mars-men Paid Search Youtube Manager posting. E002/E076/E037/E003/E006/E020/E009/E043/E095 support summary. No unsupported YouTube-only spend/result, Northbeam expertise, supplement marketing compliance or DTC subscription tenure invented.
